items.summary: fix(update): avoid duplicate database copies while the Gateway is stopped (#198148) * fix(update): avoid duplicate database copies while stopped Use the existing maintenance custody and drained-family fact before eager read preparation. Reuse the completed stopped backup image for registry rediscovery while retaining current filesystem inventory and source mutation checks. Preserve backup publication, migration, and rollback contracts. * fix(update): reuse stopped WAL databases without inspection copies Checkpoint committed WAL frames once under the native updater handoff before recording backup identities. Retain the pinned-reader fallback, final-image integrity validation, and primary rollback payload. Read journal-free databases directly under maintenance custody across Doctor and read-only worker paths. Resolve file aliases before selecting immutable reads. Add WAL and alias regressions plus serial synthetic measurement tooling. * fix(update): carry immutable reads through auth worker IPC * test(perf): preserve native safety in byte-copy update proof * test(perf): retain checks for agents created by update Doctor * test(update): verify WAL capture after capacity admission * test(perf): reclaim sparse staging space between update arms * fix(update): admit backup capacity before WAL checkpointing

Preserve OpenClaw ID membership policy and existing default-enabled authorization. * test: enable named-role enforcement in policy fixtures Give enforcement fixtures explicit valid defaults so definitions-only config continues to test its separate unrestricted contract without weakening any assertion. * fix: preserve compact test capacity and bound role handler size Recognize the exact qualified Gateway core/client selection when inventory packing combines them. Move role assignment validation to its profile-access owner without changing lazy config reads, keeping users.ts within the line-growth ratchet.

items.summary: 程式語言Rust開發團隊發布Rust 1.100.0，套件管理工具Cargo新增依賴套件發布冷卻期，讓開發者延後採用剛上架的套件版本，降低軟體供應鏈攻擊風險。新版也正式支援歷經10年5次進入穩定階段嘗試未果的Never Type，並開放自訂記憶體配置器的核心介面。
